title: Stage 5: Production hardening
summary: Pinned, chiseled, non-root, limited and checked: turn the working image into one you can run in production.

steps.title: The hardened version
body: - **pinned** SDK patch version and a lock file with `--locked-mode`: the same commit builds the same image;
- **chiseled** runtime: no shell, no package manager, far fewer CVEs; non-root by default, and `USER $APP_UID` makes it explicit;
- **read-only** root filesystem, **memory and CPU limits**, a **restart policy**, **rotated logs**;
- the image is deployed by an immutable version tag built in CI, never `latest`.

steps.prompt: With the chiseled image, a Docker `HEALTHCHECK` using `curl` no longer works. What is a sound approach?
options: Let the orchestrator probe `/health` over HTTP from outside (Kubernetes probes), or ship a tiny health-probe binary in the image
Install curl with apt-get in the final stage
Switch back to the SDK image
steps.explain: Chiseled images have no package manager by design. Kubernetes HTTP probes need nothing inside the container.

items: Log rotation with max-size and max-file
A chiseled base with no shell
A memory limit and restart policy

steps.prompt: With `read_only: true`, the app crashes writing to `/tmp`. What is the right fix?
options: Mount a tmpfs at /tmp (`tmpfs: [/tmp]` in Compose) so only that path is writable, in memory

steps.title: Production readiness score
prompt: Write `List<string> Readiness(List<string> lines)` that grades a Dockerfile. Output one line per check, `[x] NAME` when it passes or `[ ] NAME` when it fails, in this order, then `score: P/6`:
1. `base images pinned`: every `FROM` image has a tag that is not `latest`, or a digest (`@`). Skip `scratch` and names of earlier stages. (Look at the part after the last `/` for the tag.)
3. `runtime is not the SDK`: the last `FROM` image does not contain `/sdk`.
4. `runs as non-root`: the final stage has a `USER` and the last one is not `root` or `0`.
5. `exec-form start command`: the last `ENTRYPOINT` or `CMD` in the final stage starts with `[`.
6. `no secrets in ENV or ARG`: no `ENV`/`ARG` line contains `PASSWORD`, `SECRET` or `TOKEN` (any case).
Instructions may be in any case; skip blank and `#` lines.
solution: bool pinned = true, secrets = false, nonRoot = false;
else if (keyword == "USER") nonRoot = t.Length > 1 && t[1] != "root" && t[1] != "0";
else if ((keyword == "ENV" || keyword == "ARG") && (line.ToUpper().Contains("PASSWORD") || line.ToUpper().Contains("SECRET") || line.ToUpper().Contains("TOKEN"))) secrets = true;
var checks = new List<(string Name, bool Ok)>
template: var dojoHard = new List<string> { "# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1", "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0.100 AS build", "WORKDIR /src", "COPY TodoApi.csproj packages.lock.json ./", "RUN dotnet restore --locked-mode", "COPY . .", "RUN dotnet publish -c Release -o /app/publish --no-restore", "", "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0-noble-chiseled AS final", "WORKDIR /app", "COPY --from=build /app/publish .", "USER $APP_UID", "ENV ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS=8080", "ENTRYPOINT [\"dotnet\", \"TodoApi.dll\"]" };

Dojo.Eq("hardened file", new List<string> { "[x] base images pinned", "[x] multi-stage build", "[x] runtime is not the SDK", "[x] runs as non-root", "[x] exec-form start command", "[x] no secrets in ENV or ARG", "score: 6/6" }, Readiness(dojoHard));
var dojoNaive = new List<string> { "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk", "WORKDIR /src", "COPY . .", "ENV DB_PASSWORD=dev", "RUN dotnet publish -c Release -o /app", "CMD dotnet /app/TodoApi.dll" };

Dojo.Eq("naive file", new List<string> { "[ ] base images pinned", "[ ] multi-stage build", "[ ] runtime is not the SDK", "[ ] runs as non-root", "[ ] exec-form start command", "[ ] no secrets in ENV or ARG", "score: 0/6" }, Readiness(dojoNaive));

var dojoMid = new List<string> { "from mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0 as build", "RUN dotnet publish -o /out", "FROM build AS test", "RUN dotnet test", "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:latest", "USER app", "COPY --from=build /out .", "USER root", "ENTRYPOINT [\"dotnet\", \"TodoApi.dll\"]" };

Dojo.Eq("stage 3 file with leftovers", new List<string> { "[ ] base images pinned", "[x] multi-stage build", "[x] runtime is not the SDK", "[ ] runs as non-root", "[x] exec-form start command", "[x] no secrets in ENV or ARG", "score: 4/6" }, Readiness(dojoMid));
hints: Reset the non-root flag and the start command on every FROM: only the final stage counts.
Check whether a FROM image is an earlier stage name **before** adding this stage's own name.
Collect `(name, ok)` pairs, then format them and count the passes.
